concepts.name: Vectors & Resolution of Forces
concepts.description: Vector addition, scalar/vector products, resolution in orthogonal axes.

concepts.name: Free Body Diagrams & Equilibrium
concepts.description: Drawing isolated bodies, normal contact forces, tension, Newton's 1st and 3rd laws.

concepts.name: Newton's Second Law & Accelerated Frames
concepts.description: F_net = ma, pseudo forces in non-inertial reference frames, constraint relations.

concepts.name: Static & Kinetic Friction
concepts.description: Coefficient of friction, limiting friction, two-block problems, direction of friction.

concepts.name: Dynamics of Circular Motion
concepts.description: Centripetal acceleration, banking of roads, vertical circular motion critical velocity.

concepts.name: Work-Energy Theorem
concepts.description: Work done by variable forces, kinetic energy change, conservative and non-conservative forces.

concepts.name: Conservation of Mechanical Energy & Potential Energy
concepts.description: Potential energy curves U(x), equilibrium stability (dU/dx=0), spring mass systems.

concepts.name: Moment of Inertia & Theorems
concepts.description: Parallel and perpendicular axis theorems, radius of gyration, continuous body integration.

concepts.name: Torque and Conservation of Angular Momentum
concepts.description: Tau = I*alpha, angular momentum L = r x p = I*omega, conservation in collision problems.

concepts.name: Pure Rolling & Combined Translation-Rotation
concepts.description: Condition v = omega*R, friction in rolling, acceleration on inclined planes.

concepts.name: Coulomb's Law & Electric Field
concepts.description: Point charges, superposition principle, continuous charge distributions (ring, line).

concepts.name: Gauss's Law & Flux
concepts.description: Electric flux, spherical, cylindrical, and planar symmetric Gauss surfaces, conductor cavities.

concepts.name: Electric Potential and Capacitance
concepts.description: Potential gradient E = -grad(V), capacitance, dielectrics, energy stored in capacitors.

concepts.name: Functions, Domain and Range
concepts.description: Types of functions (injective, surjective, bijective), domain determination, composite functions.

concepts.name: Graph Transformations & Modulus
concepts.description: Transformations f(x+a), af(x), |f(x)|, f(|x|), greatest integer [x], fractional part {x}.

concepts.name: Limits & Indeterminate Forms
concepts.description: Evaluation of 0/0, inf/inf, 1^inf forms, L'Hopital's Rule, Taylor standard expansions.

concepts.name: Continuity of Functions
concepts.description: LHL = RHL = f(a), types of discontinuities, Intermediate Value Theorem.

concepts.name: Differentiability & Derivatives
concepts.description: Right-hand and left-hand derivatives, corner points, differentiability implies continuity.

concepts.name: Application of Derivatives: Monotonicity & Extrema
concepts.description: f'(x) sign analysis, maxima and minima, Rolle's and Lagrange Mean Value Theorems.

concepts.name: Indefinite Integration Techniques
concepts.description: Substitution, integration by parts, partial fractions, special standard integrals.

concepts.name: Definite Integrals & King's Property
concepts.description: Properties integral f(a+b-x)dx, Leibniz rule of differentiation under integral sign.

concepts.name: Roots, Discriminant & Location of Roots
concepts.description: Sum and product of roots, condition for common roots, location of roots relative to k.

concepts.name: First Law of Thermodynamics & Enthalpy
concepts.description: delta U = q + w, work in reversible/irreversible isothermal and adiabatic processes, delta H.

concepts.name: Entropy, Gibbs Free Energy & Spontaneity
concepts.description: Second Law, delta S_univ > 0, delta G = delta H - T*delta S, equilibrium constant relation.

concepts.name: Law of Mass Action, Kp & Kc
concepts.description: Relationship Kp = Kc(RT)^delta_n, Le Chatelier principle, reaction quotient Q.

concepts.name: pH Calculations, Buffers & Solubility Product
concepts.description: Ostwald dilution, Henderson-Hasselbalch equation for buffers, Ksp precipitation condition.

concepts.name: Inductive, Resonance & Hyperconjugation Effects
concepts.description: Mesomeric effect, stability of carbocations, carbanions, free radicals, aromaticity (Huckel Rule).

concepts.name: Acidic and Basic Strength Comparisons
concepts.description: pKa comparisons, ortho effect in benzoic acids, substituted anilines and phenols.

prerequisites.description: Resolving components is required to construct free body diagram equations.
Equilibrium FBD is the foundation for accelerated frame dynamic equations.
Normal reaction determination from NLM is required to compute limiting friction.
Centripetal acceleration dynamics builds on Newton's second law.
Work-energy theorem integrates Newton's second law over displacement.
Conservative forces and potential energy define mechanical energy conservation.
Torque requires lever arm and force decomposition from equilibrium concepts.
Rotational dynamics Tau = I*alpha requires moment of inertia.
Rolling motion combines translational NLM and rotational torque equations.
Function definition and behavior are needed for graphing transformations.
Understanding domain and function behavior around critical points is needed for limits.
Continuity at x=a is defined strictly through limit existence (LHL = RHL = f(a)).
A function must be continuous to be differentiable; derivative limits rely on continuity.
Monotonicity and extremum detection require calculating first and second derivatives.
Integration is the anti-derivative process.
Definite integrals apply fundamental theorem of calculus over indefinite primitives.
Enthalpy delta H from First Law is required to calculate Gibbs Free Energy delta G.
Spontaneity delta G_0 = -RT ln K connects thermodynamics with chemical equilibrium.
Ionic equilibrium applies mass action laws to weak electrolyte dissociation.
Resonance and inductive stabilization of conjugate bases determines acid strength.
